method: chronological five-positive-stat-game mean threshold and smoothed empirical frequency; position-filtered, conditional on positive production; NOT sportsbook-line calibration
leakage_policy: Each prediction uses only earlier games for the same player and market
limitations: Positive-stat selection excludes zero-production games and introduces participation/survivorship bias. No snap or injury eligibility data; synthetic thresholds, not posted odds or real SGP prices; no opponent, joint-correlation, or market EV validation
